questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.q: $\int \frac{x^3-1}{x^3+x} d x=$
questions.solution:
$I=\int\left(\frac{x^3-1}{x^3+x}\right) d x=\int\left(1-\frac{x+1}{x^3+x}\right) d x\begin{aligned}
& \Rightarrow I=\int 1 \cdot d x-\int \frac{(x+1)}{x^3+x} d x \\
& =x-\int \frac{(x+1)}{x\left(x^2+1\right)} d x
\end{aligned}\begin{aligned}
& \text{ Let } \frac{x+1}{x\left(x^2+1\right)}=\frac{A}{x}+\frac{B x+C}{x^2+1} \\
& \Rightarrow(x+1)=A\left(x^2+1\right)+(B x+C) x \\
& \Rightarrow(x+1)=(A+B) x^2+C x+A
\end{aligned}$
On comparing coefficient, we get
$\begin{aligned}
& A+B=0, C=1, A=1 \\
& \Rightarrow B=-1 \\
& \therefore I=x-\int \frac{1}{x} d x-\int \frac{(1-x)}{x^2+1} d x \\
& \Rightarrow I=x-\log |x|-\int \frac{1}{x^2+1} d x+\frac{1}{2} \int \frac{2 x}{x^2+1} d x \\
& \Rightarrow I=x-\log |x|-\tan ^{-1} x+\frac{1}{2} \log \left(x^2+1\right)+c
\end{aligned}$

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.q: $\int \sqrt{x+\sqrt{x^2+2}} d x=$
questions.solution: $\int \sqrt{x+\sqrt{x^2+2}} d x\sqrt{x+\sqrt{x^2+2}}=t \Rightarrow x+\sqrt{x^2+2}=t^2\sqrt{x^2+2}=t^2-x\Rightarrow x^2+2=t^4+x^2-2 t^2 x\Rightarrow \mathrm{x}=\frac{\mathrm{t}^4-2}{2 \mathrm{t}^2} \Rightarrow \mathrm{dx}=\frac{\mathrm{t}^4+2}{\mathrm{t}^3} \mathrm{dt}\int \mathrm{t} \cdot \frac{\mathrm{t}^4+2}{\mathrm{t}^3} \mathrm{dt}=\int\left(\mathrm{t}^2+\frac{2}{\mathrm{t}^2}\right) \mathrm{dt}=\frac{\mathrm{t}^3}{3}-\frac{2}{\mathrm{t}}+\mathrm{C}=\frac{t^3}{3}-\frac{2}{t}+C=\frac{t^4-6}{3 t}+C=\frac{\left(x+\sqrt{x^2+2}\right)^2-6}{3 \sqrt{x+\sqrt{x^2+2}}}+C$

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.q: The value of $\int e^{\tan \theta}(\sec \theta-\sin \theta) d \theta$ is
questions.solution:
Let $I=\int e^{\tan \theta}(\sec \theta-\sin \theta) d \theta$
Put $\tan \theta=t \Rightarrow \sec ^2 \theta d \theta=d t \Rightarrow d \theta=\frac{d t}{1+t^2}\Rightarrow I=\int e^t\left(\sqrt{1+t^2}-\frac{t}{\sqrt{1+t^2}}\right) \frac{d t}{1+t^2}=\int e^t\left(\frac{1}{\sqrt{1+t^2}}-\frac{t}{\left(1+t^2\right)^{3 / 2}}\right) d t$
Integrating first part by parts we have,
$=\frac{1}{\sqrt{1+t^2}} e^t+\int \frac{t}{\left(1+t^2\right)^{3 / 2}} \cdot e^t d t-\int \frac{t}{\left(1+t^2\right)^{3 / 2}} e^t d t+c=\frac{e^t}{\sqrt{1+t^2}}+c=e^{\tan \theta} \cos \theta+c$

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.q: $\int \tan ^{-1} \sqrt{\mathrm{x}} \mathrm{dx}$ is equal to
questions.solution:
We have, $I=\int 1 \cdot \tan ^{-1} \sqrt{\mathrm{x}} \mathrm{dx}$
Using by parts,
$\begin{aligned} \\ I & =\tan ^{-1} \sqrt{x} \cdot(x)-\int \frac{1}{1+x} \times \frac{1}{2 \sqrt{x}} \times x d x \\ \\ & =x \tan ^{-1} \sqrt{x} \cdot-\int \frac{x}{(1+x) 2 \sqrt{x}} d x \\ \\ & =x \tan ^{-1} \sqrt{x}-\int\left(\frac{1+x}{(1+x) 2 \sqrt{x}}-\frac{1}{(1+x) 2 \sqrt{x}}\right) d x \\ \\ & =x \tan ^{-1} \sqrt{x}-\int \frac{d x}{2 \sqrt{x}}+\int \frac{d x}{2 \sqrt{x}(1+x)} \\ \\ & =x \tan ^{-1} \sqrt{x}-\sqrt{x}+\tan ^{-1} \sqrt{x}+C \\ \\ & =(x+1) \tan ^{-1} \sqrt{x}-\sqrt{x}+C \\ \end{aligned}$

Let $\mathrm{x}=\mathrm{a} \sin ^2 \theta$
then $d x=2 a \sin \theta \cos \theta d \theta$

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.q: If $\int \frac{\mathrme^{\mathrm{x}}(1+\sin \mathrm{x}) \mathrm{dx}}{1+\cos \mathrm{x}}=\mathrme^{\mathrm{x}} \mathrm{f}(\mathrm{x})+\mathrm{C}$, then $\mathrm{f}(\mathrm{x})$ is equal to
questions.solution:
$\int e^x \frac{(1+\sin x)}{(1+\cos x)} d x$
$=\int e^x\left[\frac{1}{2} \sec ^2 \frac{x}{2}+\tan \frac{x}{2}\right] d x$
$=\frac{1}{2} \int e^x \sec ^2 \frac{x}{2} d x+\int e^x \tan \frac{x}{2} d x$
$=\mathrme^{\mathrm{x}} \tan \frac{\mathrm{x}}{2}+\mathrm{C}$
But $\mathrm{I}=\mathrme^{\mathrm{x}} \mathrm{f}(\mathrm{x})+\mathrm{C}$ (given)
$\therefore \mathrm{f}(\mathrm{x})=\tan \frac{\mathrm{x}}{2}$

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.q: $\int \frac{x+3}{(x+4)^2} e^x d x$ is equal to
questions.solution:
Suppose,
$I=\int \frac{x+3}{(x+4)^2} e^x d x=\int \frac{(x+4) 1}{(x+4)^2} e^x d x$
$=\int \frac{e^x}{(x+4)}-\int \frac{e^x}{(x+4)^2} d x$
$=\int e^x\left(\frac{1}{(x+4)}-\frac{1}{(x+4)^2}\right) d x$
$=e^x \frac{1}{(x+4)}+C$
$\left[\int e^x \left\{f(x)+f^{\prime}(x)\right\}$ d x=e^x f(x)+C\right]

questions.q: The value of $\int \frac{1}{\left[(x-1)^3(x+2)^5\right]^{\frac{1}{4}}} d x$, is
questions.solution: $I=\int \frac{1}{\left(\frac{x-1}{x+2}\right)^{3 / 4}(x+2)^2} d x$ Let $\frac{x-1}{x+2}=t \Rightarrow \frac{3 d x}{(x+2)^2}=d t \begin{aligned} \Rightarrow \quad$ I & =$\frac{1}{3} \int \frac{1}{t^{3 / 4}}$ d t=$\frac{1}{3}\left(\frac{t^{1 / 4}}{1 / 4}\right)+$ C \\ & =$\frac{4}{3}$ t^{1 / 4}+C=$\frac{4}{3}\left(\frac{x-1}{x+2}\right)^{1 / 4}+$ C \end{aligned}

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.q: Let $f(x)=\int \frac{x^2 d x}{\left(1+x^2\right)\left(1+\sqrt{\left.1+x^2\right)}\right.}$ and $f(0)=0$, then the value of $f(1)$ be
questions.solution: $f(x)=\int \frac{x^2 d x}{\left(1+x^2\right)\left(1+\sqrt{1+x^2}\right)}$ Let $x=\tan \theta\Rightarrow \quad d x=\sec ^2 \theta d \theta=\left(1+x^2\right) d \thetaf(x)=\int \frac{x^2 d x}{\left(1+x^2\right)\left(1+\sqrt{1+x^2}\right)}=\int \frac{\tan ^2 \theta \sec ^2 \theta d \theta}{\sec ^2 \theta(1+\sec \theta)}=\int \frac{\tan ^2 \theta d \theta}{1+\sec \theta}=\int \frac{\sin ^2 \theta d \theta}{\cos \theta(1+\cos \theta)}=\int \frac{1-\cos ^2 \theta d \theta}{\cos \theta(1+\cos \theta)}=\int \frac{(1-\cos \theta) d \theta}{\cos \theta}=\int \sec \theta d \theta-\int d \theta=\log \left(x+\sqrt{1+x^2}\right)-\tan ^{-1} x+C\therefore \quad f(0)=\log (0+\sqrt{1+0})-\tan ^{-1}(0)+C0=\log 1-0+C\Rightarrow \quad C=0\therefore \quad f(1)=\log \left(1+\sqrt{1+1^2}\right)-\tan ^{-1}(1)=\log (1+\sqrt{2})-\frac{\pi}{4}$

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.q: If $\int \frac{\sin x}{\sin (x-\alpha)} \mathrm{d} \mathrm{x}=\mathrm{A} x+\mathrm{B} \log \sin (x-\alpha)+\mathrm{C}$, then value of $(A, B)$ is
questions.solution: $\int \frac{\sin x}{\sin (x-\alpha)} \mathrm{dx}=\int \frac{\sin (x-\alpha+\alpha}{\sin (x-\alpha)} \mathrm{dx}=\int \frac{\sin (x-\alpha) \cos \alpha+\cos (x-\alpha) \sin \alpha}{\sin (x-\alpha)} \mathrm{d} \mathrm{x}=\int\{\cos \alpha+\sin \alpha \cot (x-\alpha)\} \mathrm{d} \mathrm{x}=(\cos \alpha) x+(\sin \alpha) \log \sin (x-\alpha)+\mathrm{C}\therefore \mathrm{A}=\cos \alpha, \mathrm{B}=\sin \alpha$

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.q: The value of $\int \cos (\log x) \mathrm{d} \mathrm{x}$ is :
questions.solution:
Let

\(\mathrm{I}=\int \cos (\log \mathrm{x}) \cdot 1 \mathrm{~d} \mathrm{x} \ldots . . \text{ (i) }\)

Use integral by parts,

\(\begin{aligned} &I=\cos (\log x) \cdot x-\int[-\sin (\log x)] \cdot \frac{1}{x} \cdot x d x \\ &=x \cdot \cos (\log x)+\int \sin (\log x) \cdot 1 d x \\ &=x \cdot \cos (\log x)+\left[\sin (\log x) \cdot x-\int \cos (\log x) \cdot \frac{1}{x} \cdot x d x\right]+C \\ &=x \cdot(\log x)+\left[x \sin (\log x)-\int \cos (\log x) d x\right]+C \\ &=x\{\sin (\log x)+\cos (\log x)\}-I+C[f r o m \text{ Eq. (i) }] \\ &\Rightarrow I=\frac{x}{2}\{\sin (\log x)+\cos (\log x)\}+C \end{aligned}\)

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.q: If $\int \frac{3 x+1}{(x-3)(x-5)} d x=\int \frac{-5}{(x-3)} d x+\int \frac{B}{(x-5)} d x$ then the value of $B$ is
questions.solution: $We have, \begin{array}{l} \frac{3 x+1}{(x-3)(x-5)}=\frac{-5}{x-3}+\frac{\mathrm{B}}{x-5} \\ 3 x+1=-5(x-5)+\mathrm{B}(x-3) \\ \text{ Put } x=5 \\ 3(5)+1=\mathrm{B}(5-3) \\ 16=2 \mathrm{ B} \text{ or } \mathrm{B}=8 \end{array}$

questions.q: The integral $∫ \left(1 + x - \dfrac{1}{x}\right)e^{x + \dfrac{1}{x}}dx$ is equal to
questions.solution:
We have,&

$I = ∫ \left(1 + x - \dfrac{1}{x}\right)e^{x + \dfrac{1}{x}}dx$

$I = ∫ e^{x + \dfrac{1}{x}}dx + ∫ \left(x - \dfrac{1}{x}\right)e^{x + \dfrac{1}{x}}dx$

$I = ∫ e^{x + \dfrac{1}{x}}dx + ∫ x\left(1 - \dfrac{1}{x2}\right)e^{x + \dfrac{1}{x}}dx$

$I = ∫ e^{x + \dfrac{1}{x}}dx + xe^{x + \dfrac{1}{x}} - ∫ e^{x + \dfrac{1}{x}}dx$

$I = xe^{x + \dfrac{1}{x}} + C$

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.q: Let $P\left(x\right) = ∫ \dfrac{dx}{e^{x} + 8e^{- x} + 4e^{- 3x}}, Q\left(x\right) = ∫ \dfrac{dx}{e^{3x} + 8e^{x} + 4e^{- x}}$ and $R  \left(x\right) = P   \left(x\right) - 2Q \left(x\right)$. If $R\left(x\right) = \dfrac{1}{2} A \left(\dfrac{B + 2e^{- x}}{C}\right)$+K,then the $value of \left(A, B, C\right)& is$
questions.solution:
We have, $R\left(x\right) = ∫ \dfrac{dx}{e^{x} + 8e^{- x} + 4e^{- 3x}} - 2 ∫ \dfrac{dx}{e^{3x} + 8e^{x} + 4e^{- x}}$

$⇒ R\left(x\right) = ∫ \dfrac{e^{x}\left(e^{2x} - 2\right)}{e^{4x} + 8e^{2x} + 4}dx$

we get $R\left(t\right) = ∫ \dfrac{\left(t^{2} - 2\right)dt}{t^{4} + 8t^{2} + 4} = ∫ \dfrac{\left(1 - 2t^{- 2}\right)dt}{\left(t + 2t^{- 1}\right)^{2} + 4}$

$= \dfrac{1}{2}\tan^{-1}\left(\dfrac{t + 2t^{- 1}}{2}\right) + K$

$⇒ R\left(x\right) = \dfrac{1}{2}\tan^{-1}\left(\dfrac{e^{x} + 2e^{- x}}{2}\right) + K$

Hence, $\left(A, B, C\right) =\left(\tan^{-1},e^{x}, 2\right)$

$∴$ Option (b) is correct.

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.q: If $∫ \dfrac{( \sqrt{x}{)}^{5}dx}{( \sqrt{x}{)}^{7} + x^{6}} = \lambdalog\left(\dfrac{x9}{x^{9} + 1}\right) + C$, then $a + \lambda$ equal to
questions.solution:
Let $I = ∫ \dfrac{dx}{\left(\sqrt{x}\right)^{2} + \left(\sqrt{x}\right)^{7}}$

$= ∫ \dfrac{dx}{\left(\sqrt{x}\right)^{7}\left(\dfrac{1}{( \sqrt{x}{)}^{5}} + 1\right)}$

Put $1 + \dfrac{1}{\left(\sqrt{x}\right)^{5}} = t$

$⇒ - \dfrac{5}{2} \cdot \dfrac{1}{( \sqrt{x}{)}^{7}}dx = dt$

$∴ I = - \dfrac{2}{5} ∫ \dfrac{dt}{t} = \dfrac{- 2}{5}logt + C$

$= \dfrac{- 2}{5}\log\left[1 + \dfrac{1}{\left(\sqrt{x}\right)^{5}}\right] + C$

$= - \dfrac{2}{5}\log\left(\dfrac{x^{5 / 2} + 1}{x5 / 2}\right) + C$

$⇒ \lambda = \dfrac{- 2}{5}$ and $a = \dfrac{5}{2}$

$∴ a + \lambda = 2. 1 > 2$

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.q: Evaluate: $\int \frac{1}{1+3 \sin ^{2} x+8 \cos ^{2} x} \mathrm{dx}$
questions.solution: $\mathrm{I}=\int \frac{1}{1+3 \sin ^{2} \mathrm{x}+8 \cos ^{2} \mathrm{x}} \mathrm{dx}$ Dividing the numerator and denominator by $\cos ^{2} \mathrm{x},$ we get I=$\int \frac{\sec ^{2} x}{\sec ^{2} x+3 \tan ^{2} x+8}$ d x=$\int \frac{\sec ^{2} x}{4 \tan ^{2} x+9}$ d x Putting $\tan x=t \Rightarrow \sec ^{2} x d x=d t,$ we get $\mathrm{I}=\int \frac{\mathrm{dt}}{4 \mathrmt^{2}+9}=\frac{1}{4} \int \frac{\mathrm{dt}}{\mathrmt^{2}+(3 / 2)^{2}}=\frac{1}{4} \times \frac{1}{3 / 2} \tan ^{-1}\left(\frac{\mathrm{t}}{3 / 2}\right)+\mathrm{C}\Rightarrow \mathrm{I}=\frac{1}{6} \tan ^{-1}\left(\frac{2 \mathrm{t}}{3}\right)+\mathrm{C}=\frac{1}{6} \tan ^{-1}\left(\frac{2 \tan \mathrm{x}}{3}\right)+\mathrm{C}$

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.q: $\int \frac{\left(\mathrmx^{2}-1\right)}{\left(\mathrmx^{2}+1\right) \sqrt{\mathrmx^{4}+1}} \mathrm{dx}$ is equal to
questions.solution: $\mathrm{I}=\int \frac{\mathrmx^{2}\left(1-\frac{1}{\mathrmx^{2}}\right) \mathrm{dx}}{\mathrmx^{2}\left(\mathrm{x}+\frac{1}{\mathrm{x}}\right)\left(\mathrmx^{2}+\frac{1}{\mathrmx^{2}}\right)^{1 / 2}}$ Let $\mathrm{x}+\frac{1}{\mathrm{x}}=\mathrm{p} \Rightarrow\left(1-\frac{1}{\mathrmx^{2}}\right) \mathrm{d} \mathrm{x}=\mathrm{dp}\mathrm{I}=\int \frac{\mathrm{dp}}{\mathrm{p} \sqrt{\mathrmp^{2}-2}}=\frac{1}{\sqrt{2}} \mathrm\sec^{-1} \frac{\mathrm{p}}{\sqrt{2}}=\frac{1}{\sqrt{2}} \sec ^{-1}\left(\frac{\mathrmx^{2}+1}{\sqrt{2} \mathrm{x}}\right)+\mathrm{c}$

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.q: Evaluate: $\int \sqrt{\frac{\mathrm{x}}{4-\mathrmx^{3}}} \mathrm{dx}$
questions.solution: $I=\int \sqrt{\frac{x}{4-x^{3}}} d x=\int \frac{\sqrt{x} d x}{\sqrt{4-x^{3}}}$ Here integral of $\sqrt{x}=\frac{2}{3} x^{3 / 2}$ and $4-x^{3}=4-\left(x^{3 / 2}\right)^{2}$ Put $x^{3 / 2}=t \Rightarrow \sqrt{x} d x=\frac{2}{3} d t$ So $I=\frac{2}{3} \int \frac{d t}{\sqrt{4-t^{2}}}=\frac{2}{3} \sin ^{-1}\left(\frac{x^{3 / 2}}{2}\right)+c$

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.q: Evaluate \(\int \frac{x^2}{x^2-1} d x\)
questions.solution:
Given integral \(I=\int\left(1+\frac{1}{x^2-1}\right) d x\)
\(\begin{aligned}
& =\int d x+\int \frac{d x}{(x-1)(x+1)} \\
& =x+\frac{1}{2} \int\left(\frac{1}{x-1}-\frac{1}{x+1}\right) d x=x+\frac{1}{2} \log \left(\frac{x-1}{x+1}\right)+c
\end{aligned}\)

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.q: The slope of the tangent to the hyperbola \(2 x²-3 y²=6\) at \((3,2)\) is
questions.solution:
Differentiating the given equation of the curve
\begin{aligned}& 4 x-6 y \cdot($\mathrm{dy}$/ $\mathrm{dx}$)=0 \quad \therefore $\mathrm{dy}$/ $\mathrm{dx}=$2 $\mathrm{x}$/ 3 $\mathrm{y}$\\
& $\left(\frac{\mathrm{dy}}{\mathrm{dx}}\right)_{(3,2)}=\frac{2}{3}\cdot\frac{3}{2}=1
\end{aligned}$

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.q: The equation of tangent to the curve \(y=\sin x\) at the point \((\pi, 0)\) is
questions.solution:
\(y=\sin x \Rightarrow $\frac{d y}{d x}=\cos$x \Rightarrow$\left(\frac{d y}{d x}\right)_{(\pi, 0)}=-$1\)
Therefore the equation of tangent at \(($\pi,$0)\) is given by
\(y-0=-1(x-$\pi) \Rightarrow$x+y=$\pi$

questions.q:
If \($\int \frac{2 \cos x-\sin x+\lambda}{\cos x+\sin x-2}$d x\) \(=A \ln |\cos x+\sin x-2|+B x+C\).
Then the ordered triplet \(A, B, \lambda\) is -
questions.solution:
$$\begin{aligned} \frac{\mathrm{d}}{\mathrm{dx}}(\mathrm{A} \ln |\cos \mathrm{x}+\sin \mathrm{x}-2|+\mathrm{Bx}+\mathrm{C})\\
&= \mathrm{A} \frac{\cos \mathrm{x}-\sin \mathrm{x}}{\cos \mathrm{x}+\sin \mathrm{x}-2}+\mathrm{B}\\
&= \frac{\mathrm{A} \cos \mathrm{x}-\mathrm{A} \sin \mathrm{x}+\mathrm{B} \cos \mathrm{x}+\mathrm{B} \sin \mathrm{x}-2 \mathrm{ B}}{\cos \mathrm{x}+\sin \mathrm{x}-2}\\
& \therefore 2=\mathrm{A}+\mathrm{B} \text{ or }-1=-\mathrm{A}+\mathrm{B}; \lambda=-2 \mathrm{ B}\\
& \therefore \mathrm{A}=3 / 2, \mathrm{ B}=1 / 2, \lambda=-1
\end{aligned}$$\)
